## Description

Provide a concise explanation of the changes introduced by this pull request.

## Related Issues

Fixes #(issue number)

## Type of Change

- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)
- [ ] Documentation update
- [ ] Refactoring or performance improvement

## Checklist

- [ ] My code follows the code style and conventions of this project (see [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md)).
- [ ] Linting and formatting checks pass (`pnpm run lint` and `pnpm run format:check`).
- [ ] I have added tests that prove my fix is effective or that my feature works.
- [ ] All existing and new tests pass locally (`pnpm test`).
- [ ] Type checking passes (`pnpm run typecheck`).
- [ ] Build succeeds without errors (`pnpm run build`).
